tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: The purpose of this section is to promote scientific and academic excellence through collaborations between institutions of higher education and National Laboratories.

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish a program to support the joint appointment of distinguished scientists by institutions of higher education and National Laboratories.

tree.heading: Qualifications
tree.text: To be eligible for appointment as a distinguished scientist under this section, an individual, by reason of professional background and experience, shall be able to bring international recognition to the appointing institution of higher education or National Laboratory in the field of scientific endeavor of the individual.

tree.heading: Selection
tree.text: A distinguished scientist appointed under this section shall be selected through an open, competitive process.

children.heading: Institution of higher education
children.text: An appointment by an institution of higher education under this section shall be filled within the tenure allotment of the institution of higher education, at a minimum rank of professor.

children.heading: National Laboratory
children.text: An appointment by a National Laboratory under this section shall be at the rank of the highest grade of distinguished scientist or technical staff of the National Laboratory.

tree.heading: Duration
tree.text: An appointment under this section shall—

children.text: be for a term of 6 years; and

tree.heading: Use of funds
tree.text: Funds made available under this section may be used for—

children.text: the salary of the distinguished scientist and support staff;
such other requirements as the Secretary determines to be necessary to carry out the purpose of the program.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The appointment of a distinguished scientist under this section shall be reviewed at the end of the first 3-year allotment for the distinguished scientist through an open peer-review process to determine whether the appointment is meeting the purpose of this section under subsection (a).

children.heading: Funding
children.text: Funding of the appointment of the distinguished scientist for the second 3-year allotment shall be determined based on the review conducted under paragraph (1).

tree.heading: Cost sharing
tree.text: To be eligible for assistance under this section, an appointing institution of higher education shall pay at least 50 percent of the total costs of the appointment.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section—

notes.text: 2011—Subsec. (j)(4) to (6). Pub. L. 111–358 added pars. (4) to (6).
